_note: REFRESHED (17) for the Skill Tree page (2026-09-18), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. All four planner scenarios moved UP by a few renders: P-02 6356->6365 (+9), P-03 12300->12317 (+17), P-04 6376->6383 (+7), P-05 2087->2090 (+3). One structural cause: the site header carries a seventh section link (Skill Tree), and the header's links render on every shell commit the interaction takes, so each scenario pays one more component per commit - 3 to 17 commits apiece, which is exactly the spread. Nothing on the planner tabs the scenarios drive changed. Figures are the CI runner's own capture (run 35372227239), the instrument this guard compares against. Previous note (16): REFRESHED (16) for the hover cards (2026-09-17), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. All four planner scenarios moved DOWN: P-02 8290->6356 (-1934), P-03 14381->12300 (-2081), P-04 7440->6376 (-1064), P-05 2450->2087 (-363). One structural cause in the app: every gear and ability tile in a roster row used to carry its own always-mounted base-ui Tooltip subtree (Root/Trigger/Portal, reconciling on every commit the row took); the hover card is now a hook the art primitive itself calls, and its trigger is a bare span until the first pointer reaches it, so a row's icons cost no component per commit until one is hovered - fewer components than the native-title era the previous refresh replaced, since the tiles' old Tooltips are gone too. That accounts for P-03/P-04/P-05 and 1230 of P-02's drop (7060 with the harness of the previous refresh). The other 704 of P-02 is a harness change, made because the CI capture of this branch would not agree with the host's: the driver now brings the pointer onto the target and lets it settle 800ms BEFORE the window opens, where it used to park it in a corner and let the first input's own pointer travel be measured. Two runner-only deltas fell out of that travel. P-02 read +-1 from repetition to repetition on both machines (a 200ms tooltip open timer racing the eight clicks that followed the pointer's arrival), and the median fell on different sides on the two; it is deterministic now at 6356. P-04 read +7 on the runner and not on the host: the precondition's click on the switch-hero button lands at the button's centre, the hero's name is a tooltip trigger in the middle of that button, and with the runner's fallback font the name reaches the centre - a tooltip the pointer has once crossed re-renders its base-ui root on every commit after that until the strip remounts (one render x seven commits). The precondition now clicks the button on its avatar, where no font puts a trigger. Numbers are the host capture (PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile), deterministic across seven repetitions and identical across two captures; the runner is expected to reproduce them exactly. Previous note: REFRESHED (15) for converting the hero strip's native title tooltips to the design-system Tooltip (2026-09-15, #230), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. All four planner scenarios moved UP: P-02 7934->8290 (+356), P-03 13952->14381 (+429), P-04 7314->7440 (+126), P-05 2399->2450 (+51). One structural cause: four native `title` tips on the always-mounted hero strip (the truncated hero name, and the Sustained/Active/Hit figures) became DS Tooltips, and each base-ui Tooltip subtree (Root/Trigger/Portal/Positioner/Popup) reconciles on every commit the strip takes - the same per-commit cost AbbreviatedNumber carries, which #230 cited as the correct pattern. Memoising does not remove it: the cost is the primitive's own subtree per commit, not prop churn (the same finding the sheet-table measurement recorded). Numbers are the CI capture of this change; render counts are deterministic, so the local host capture (PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile) reproduces them exactly. Previous note: REFRESHED (14) for the shared gear slot card (2026-09-14), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard. The three scenarios that render the Gear tab moved DOWN: P-03 13986->13952 (-34), P-04 7328->7314 (-14), P-05 2405->2399 (-6); P-02 is unchanged at 7934, so the memo(SlotEditor) boundary rule 6 protects still holds. One structural cause: the per-slot stats grid that mounted eight stat boxes as a second row under the slot editors is gone - each SlotEditor now wraps one GearSlotCard that draws the item and its stats together - so every commit that reaches the Gear tab renders eight fewer components. The CI capture of the change (13952/7314/2399) and the local capture on the host (PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile) agree exactly, deterministic across repetitions. Previous note: REFRESHED (12) for hosting the shell toast in the app shell instead of the planner slot (2026-09-14), per docs/react-performance.md rule 10's deliberate-change path - never by widening the guard, which compares exactly on purpose. All four scenarios moved DOWN: P-02 7942->7912 (-30), P-03 14002->13939 (-63), P-04 7335->7307 (-28), P-05 2408->2396 (-12). Measured against a CONTROL: develop's tip (80890ea2), the branch's base, reproduced the outgoing baseline exactly on the CI runner (7942/14002/7335/2408), and the local capture of this change reproduced the CI capture of it exactly, so the deltas are this change's own. One cause: HeroPlanner used to subscribe to the store's toast and render it, so every autosave flash during a scenario re-rendered the planner composer and its children; the shell now subscribes instead, and the toast's two state changes per flash reach only the shell. Captured on the host with PERF_FORCE=1 after perf:build:profile, deterministic across 7 repetitions.
